description: This file defines a custom composable component 'NiaFilterChip' for Android's Jetpack Compose UI toolkit, which wraps around the Material3 FilterChip with added styling and behavior specific to the 'Now in Android' app. It includes styling defaults, a preview composable, and related constants.

classes.name: NiaChipDefaults
classes.description: Holds default style constants for the custom chip component, including alpha transparency and border width.

methods.name: NiaFilterChip
methods.description: A composable that renders a filter chip with optional leading icon, label, and configurable states such as selected and enabled. It customizes the Material3 FilterChip with specific styles and behavior.

methods.name: ChipPreview
methods.description: A composable preview function that displays an example of the custom filter chip within the app's theme.
